premises.text: The cost of packing and shipping is hidden, obscured, or hard to determine in online transactions
premises.evidence_span: There's an element of cost in almost any online transaction that's hidden. It's obscured. It's subsidized. And this is a problem

premises.text: Target customers are small and medium retail shippers of diverse micro-niche goods, not standard boxed items
premises.evidence_span: Our customers are small and medium-sized businesses that ship a diverse group of goods. We call them micro niches

premises.text: The shipping market is fragmented and carriers will not quote unless the item is in a box, crate, or on a pallet
premises.evidence_span: The market itself is incredibly fragmented. Every different type of item requires a different type of carrier

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates fragmented carrier markets into one website so almost any item size or weight can ship to almost any destination
premises.evidence_span: we have aggregated all of these different markets into one website

premises.text: The system converts real items into packed weights and dimensions to deliver instant packing and multi-carrier shipping quotes
premises.evidence_span: we're going to convert your real item into packed weights and dimensions. This allows us to provide customers with instant data, instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes

premises.text: Shippers can schedule pickup or drop off at a ShipHawk network location, including local delivery by the same agent
premises.evidence_span: you get to schedule a pickup at your home or office. Or you can find a local ShipHawk network location where you can drop your item off

premises.text: ShipHawk earns a commission from shipping, packing, insurance, and other service providers it sends business to
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

domains.name: Hard-to-price packing and shipping for diverse retail goods

value.text: Make shipping easy so retail shippers can move almost any item with instant multi-carrier quotes from one site
value.evidence_span: help us make shipping easy for everyone

secondary_value.text: Save shippers real money and real time on packing and shipping
secondary_value.evidence_span: It costs people real money and real time
